name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: No major cloud, CDN or payments outage over 2h found from 21 to 23 Nov; last wave ended 17 Nov
state: A run of outages from 12 to 17 Nov hit Microsoft 365, AWS US East, the FAA, Chase and Apple Pay, mostly blamed on faulty updates and maintenance rather than attacks (IBTimes, 18 Nov). Outage coverage since then, to 21 Nov, revisits those incidents and reports no new major failure (The Register). Searches to 23 Nov found no cloud, CDN or payments outage over 2h in the past 48h, so the level stays Normal.
for_you: No action is needed. Provider status pages give the quickest confirmation if a service stops working.
rubric_hit: No major multi-hour outage in the past 48h: Normal

sources.title: IBTimes UK — Cyberattacks and outages in November: the major US disruptions reported so far

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
